coverage_assessment: First-pass open-web coverage includes 28 captured query actions/727 result headers in English, Malay and Chinese; English/Malay and Chinese local press; all four February week windows; and targeted labor, health, land/farm, student, price, migrant/refugee, foreign-target and emergency/Parliament searches. Thirteen sources are retained (two body-read, eleven search-only); nine exclusions/boundary leads and seven explicit gaps preserve uncertainty. No qualifying February public gathering of at least 50 with a demand directed to Malaysia’s government was identified, but this is not evidence of absence. LexisNexis, systematic archives, some regional/Tamil coverage and the official baseline remain unavailable or pending.
